name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagrams in your brand, as self-contained HTML and SVG. Architecture, flowcharts, sequence, state machines, ER and database schemas, timelines, swimlanes, org charts, Gantt, Wardley maps, user journeys, service blueprints, UML class, lifecycle phase maps, and charts from bar, line and scatter to Sankey, treemap and heatmap, plus many more. Redraws draw.io, Mermaid, Excalidraw and PlantUML files. Exports SVG and PNG.

interface.longDescription:
Diagram Design turns a description of your system, process, or data into an editorial diagram that matches your brand. Editorial diagrams your designer won't hate. No Figma. No generic rounded boxes. No 30-minute color-picking sessions.

Describe what you need and get a self-contained HTML file with inline SVG that opens in any browser and exports to SVG or PNG. Point it at your website once and it reads your colors and fonts, so every diagram looks like the rest of your site. It also redraws draw.io, Mermaid, Excalidraw, and PlantUML files at the size and level of detail you choose.

Every node earns its place. The accent color is reserved for the one or two things the reader should look at first.

50 diagram types: architecture, architecture delta, IT current-state, flowchart, sequence, state machine, ER/data model, steps, timeline, swimlane, quadrant, radar/spider, polar chart (polar/radial lollipop), loop/flywheel, nested, tree, org chart, layer stack, exploded axonometric, axonometric site/floor plan, Venn, pyramid/funnel, treemap and marimekko, unit grid, heatmap, bar and dumbbell, waterfall, line (slopegraph, ridgeline, streamgraph, bump), Gantt and scatter charts (bubble, beeswarm, box plot), high-level, process, medallion, data flow, DP integration, DP security matrix, Sankey, fishbone, Wardley map, kanban, user journey, service blueprint, deployment, dependency graph (arc diagram), UML class, story map, database schema, SBGN, requirement traceability, and event modeling. Plus lifecycle phase maps, block decomposition trees, semantic patterns, callouts, accessible motion, and sketchy hand-drawn styling.
defaultPrompt: Make an architecture diagram of my app.
Create a flowchart for this decision process.
Redraw this Mermaid diagram at the right size and detail level.
